jam.utils.json.decorators.json_serializable(cls)[source]¶

Decorator to make a class JSON serializable.

This decorator: 1. Makes the class use JsonSerde 2. For dataclasses, ensures proper field metadata handling

Parameters:

cls (Type[T])

Return type:

Type[T]

jam.utils.json.decorators.with_json_metadata(**field_metadata)[source]¶

Class decorator to add JSON metadata to fields.

Usage:
@with_json_metadata(

field1={‘name’: ‘json_field1’, ‘skip_if_none’: True}, field2={‘name’: ‘json_field2’}

) class MyClass:

field1: str field2: str

Parameters:

field_metadata (Dict[str, Any])
